scope.included: Intake and orchestration through the atomic reconstruction handoff

verification.public_evidence: Fresh committed fixture returned 201; same-key replay returned 200 with replay=true; different payload returned 409. The successful receipt response completed in 1.735 seconds.
Private database readback found exactly one verified exact-version binding. Deployed source retrieval returned 200 in 0.688 seconds and matched the committed PDF byte for byte.

verification.requirement: real model extraction with validated PDF anchors
verification.public_evidence: One real model extraction run produced one immutable validated claim set containing all 10 expected claims, each with a validated page, region, and excerpt binding.

verification.requirement: durable leased worker and bounded retries
verification.public_evidence: The positive extraction completed through one durable attempt. An unavailable exact version failed closed after one non-retryable attempt. A temporary isolated model denial produced exactly three durable attempts and terminal failure.

verification.requirement: durable event history, outbox, and SSE reconciliation
verification.public_evidence: Four contiguous persisted events had four delivered outbox rows. Last-Event-ID replay returned the three missed events once; an unknown cursor emitted reconcile_required.

verification.requirement: atomic reconstruction handoff bound to the exact source and immutable claim set
verification.public_evidence: The deployed workflow reached RECONSTRUCTING 6.185 seconds after receipt and created exactly one pending reconstruction task referencing source version 1 and immutable claim-set version 1.

verification.requirement: negative, privacy, and logged-out deployment checks
verification.public_evidence: Anonymous mutation returned 401; invalid input returned 415; invalid bindings returned 404; logged-out queue, invoice, event, and source reads returned 200. Public responses, SSE captures, and 82 application log events had zero private-pattern, token, or database-connection matches. Both exact-source and model dependency failures produced zero claims and zero reconstruction tasks.
This completed public-safe execution manifest and the separately approval-gated TEARDOWN.md are present. The isolated application service was paused after evidence capture.

explicit_deferrals.statement: Verification shows MCP, S3, vector binding, and no fallback without private identifiers.
